title: Inspect source-authorized linked Investigate Cases for selected Command Incident
goal: Add one Class-0 already-linked Investigate Case source summary in current-page selected Command Incident JSON/HTML, preserving Independent Case and Shared link permissions without Class-2 mutations.
invariants: Product owner CAP-CMD-106 Command incident coordination; CAP-CMD-101 Work Queue current-page selected Incident is consumer; Shared Linking and Investigate Case remain separate authoritative host adapters.
Only existing linked Case refs: one optional first-party host API, no local Case status inference, no link navigation URL, no creation/mutation/permissions transfer.
Git parent PR #176 is solely source-branch ancestry, never an engineering parent.
security_properties: Independent host authorization of each link AND Investigate Case in exact principal/tenant/environment scope; no cross-object authorization transfer.
Selected/denied/foreign/missing/unselected/Task must not cause any link source lookup.
Bounds 16 distinct Cases; invalid status, ID or provenance fail generic 503 without partial Incident/Case data; native Go HTML template escapes link text.

migration.rationale: Additive selected-only projection, no persistence or schema migration.

rollback.strategy: Drop optional selected_linked_cases field/source and HTML section, preserving same Work Queue GET.
verification: Prior six-view Work Queue tests, filters and SLA/ownership selection

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-106, CAP-CMD-101, Incident and Case objects, Shared Object Linking Service, tenant and permission contracts, OPEN-013.
Parent PR #176 exact CI success, selection/authorized current page and no native merge.
outputs: Optional host LinkedCasesOwner.ReadAuthorizedLinkedCases returns source-authorized current Case references/status/link provenance for selected Incident only.
Additive JSON selected_linked_cases and escaped HTML summary; nil means source unknown, [] means source authorized empty.
acceptance_tests: Only selected current-page authorized Incident calls separate owner once with host-resolved principal/tenant/environment/ID; Task, denied, off-page, unselected do not invoke.
Accepted source returns multiple canonical existing Case IDs, statuses and link provenance in JSON and HTML; no false navigation/link write.
Unauthorized/malformed/duplicate/unbounded source data returns generic 503 with no Incident or Case metadata; XSS text escaped; missing link owner explicitly unknown.
Exact SHA three-OS Go runtime plus mandatory engineering security/manifest checks PASS.

performance_budget.rationale: At most one source adapter lookup per selected authorized Incident; no secondary scan or new route.
metrics: One source call only on selected Incident
Maximum 16 authorized linked Case refs, no source calls for Task and unselected queue
